meta.title: Update VM for TPCH
meta.body_summary: Reuse null constants in the VM and update TPC-H IR outputs to reflect the new constant register reuse, reducing IR output size.

This low-risk, automated refactor is consistent with the fast, self-merge outcome.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, added null constant reuse logic (2 lines). Updated 10 TPC-H IR expected output files (q1, q4, q6, q8, q9, q10, q11, q13, q18, q21.ir.out) to reflect the new constant register assignments, reducing overall IR lines by ~512.
